scope: Own Polygon AMM direct fixed router swaps, not an aggregator/executor.

lifecycleEvidence.basis: Current w-dex.ai app deploys normal Swap/Pools surfaces; its official presentation identifies W-DEX as Meta Whale own AMM exchange on Polygon. Current bundle binds the exact SwapRouter ABI/address and fixed pool deployer. No primary sunset/retirement notice observed.

observedText: W-DEX is a decentralized exchange (DEX) that uses an automated market maker (AMM) model with support for ERC-20 standard tokens.
W-DEX is part of the global Meta Whale ecosystem.
Swap operations are carried out using the liquidity pool.
primaryPresentation.limit: Marketing safety/immutability claims are not adopted as technical or financial assurances.

Polygon W-DEX direct SwapRouter 0x8dcac06a65bbe5b9b43368b6301598195a2c8c5a is nonproxy, using Algebra Integral infrastructure. Source fixes poolDeployer=0x0b643d3a5903ed89921b85c889797dd9887125ad and pool init-code hash; pool addresses are derived from token pair/custom-deployer salt, not supplied arbitrary call targets. No aggregator API calldata, arbitrary executor, callback entrypoint, multicall, permits or wallet grants are admitted.

The caller funds input through callback transferFrom, or payable native POL is wrapped when tokenIn is WNativeToken and router native balance suffices. Intermediate multihop outputs are router custody. Amounts and minima/maxima are raw token units; deadline is a Unix timestamp checked against block.timestamp. Pool price, fee and plugin behavior affect execution; source binding does not attest every pool/plugin dependency.

Use an explicit nonzero recipient for direct token receipt: recipient=zero means router custody. No unwrap, sweep or refund helper is admitted, so router-custody output and excess native value do not form a supported complete retrieval workflow. Prefer ERC20-funded zero-native-value swaps; payable ABI does not itself enforce zero value.

exactInput and exactOutput decode path as 20-byte token, 20-byte custom-deployer salt address, 20-byte token, with additional hops at 40-byte increments. exactInput is forward order; exactOutput reverses token order. These bytes are fixed pool-route data, not arbitrary executable calldata. The custom-deployer address contributes only to deterministic pool identity; it is not directly called.

Exact-input methods enforce amountOutMinimum; exact-output methods enforce amountInMaximum and reset amountInCached. Single-hop limitSqrtPrice can stop at a partial fill. In particular exactOutputSingle requires full amountOut only when limitSqrtPrice=0; a nonzero limit can receive less than requested. Fee-on-transfer variant uses swapWithPaymentInAdvance and checks returned pool output, not an independent recipient token balance.

W-DEX is the Meta Whale ecosystem own Polygon AMM; Algebra infrastructure does not make it an Algebra protocol relabel. Current primary app and presentation expose normal swaps and liquidity pools. Presentation retains HoliDEX branding in interface artwork; no separate HoliDEX admission is counted. No bridge, farming, LP-management or limit-order contract is activated here.

refundNativeToken().details: Useful for bundling with mint or increase liquidity that uses ether, or exact output swaps that use ether for the input amount

params.token: The contract address of the token which will be transferred to `recipient`
params.recipient: The destination address of the token
params.amountMinimum: The minimum amount of token required for a transfer

sweepToken(address,uint256,address).details: The amountMinimum parameter prevents malicious contracts from stealing the token from users

params.amountMinimum: The minimum amount of WNativeToken to unwrap

unwrapWNativeToken(uint256,address).details: The amountMinimum parameter prevents malicious contracts from stealing WNativeToken from users.

params.data: Any data passed through by the caller via the IAlgebraPoolActions#swap call
params.amount0Delta: The amount of token0 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token0 to the pool.
params.amount1Delta: The amount of token1 that was sent (negative) or must be received (positive) by the pool by the end of the swap. If positive, the callback must send that amount of token1 to the pool.

algebraSwapCallback(int256,int256,bytes).details: In the implementation you must pay the pool tokens owed for the swap. The caller of this method _must_ be checked to be a AlgebraPool deployed by the canonical AlgebraFactory. amount0Delta and amount1Delta can both be 0 if no tokens were swapped.

params.params: The parameters necessary for the multi-hop swap, encoded as `ExactInputParams` in calldata

returns.amountOut: The amount of the received token

params.params: The parameters necessary for the multi-hop swap, encoded as `ExactOutputParams` in calldata

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

getRoleMember(bytes32,uint256).details: Returns one of the accounts that have `role`. `index` must be a value between 0 and {getRoleMemberCount}, non-inclusive. WARNING: When using {getRoleMember} and {getRoleMemberCount}, make sure you perform all queries on the same block. Polygon W-DEX direct SwapRouter 0x8dcac06a65bbe5b9b43368b6301598195a2c8c5a is nonproxy, using Algebra Integral infrastructure. Source fixes poolDeployer=0x0b643d3a5903ed89921b85c889797dd9887125ad and pool init-code hash; pool addresses are derived from token pair/custom-deployer salt, not supplied arbitrary call targets. No aggregator API calldata, arbitrary executor, callback entrypoint, multicall, permits or wallet grants are admitted.

The caller funds input through callback transferFrom, or payable native POL is wrapped when tokenIn is WNativeToken and router native balance suffices. Intermediate multihop outputs are router custody. Amounts and minima/maxima are raw token units; deadline is a Unix timestamp checked against block.timestamp. Pool price, fee and plugin behavior affect execution; source binding does not attest every pool/plugin dependency.

Use an explicit nonzero recipient for direct token receipt: recipient=zero means router custody. No unwrap, sweep or refund helper is admitted, so router-custody output and excess native value do not form a supported complete retrieval workflow. Prefer ERC20-funded zero-native-value swaps; payable ABI does not itself enforce zero value.

exactInput and exactOutput decode path as 20-byte token, 20-byte custom-deployer salt address, 20-byte token, with additional hops at 40-byte increments. exactInput is forward order; exactOutput reverses token order. These bytes are fixed pool-route data, not arbitrary executable calldata. The custom-deployer address contributes only to deterministic pool identity; it is not directly called.

Exact-input methods enforce amountOutMinimum; exact-output methods enforce amountInMaximum and reset amountInCached. Single-hop limitSqrtPrice can stop at a partial fill. In particular exactOutputSingle requires full amountOut only when limitSqrtPrice=0; a nonzero limit can receive less than requested. Fee-on-transfer variant uses swapWithPaymentInAdvance and checks returned pool output, not an independent recipient token balance.

W-DEX is the Meta Whale ecosystem own Polygon AMM; Algebra infrastructure does not make it an Algebra protocol relabel. Current primary app and presentation expose normal swaps and liquidity pools. Presentation retains HoliDEX branding in interface artwork; no separate HoliDEX admission is counted. No bridge, farming, LP-management or limit-order contract is activated here.
